integrity: Two independent exact-integer, complete finite recognizers and two different signed-sum procedures were replayed; CSV certificates record all 34 five-vertex frequency orbits and the complete six-vertex edge-incidence histogram.
scientific_limitations: All exact Walsh conclusions are restricted to labelled chordal graphs on five and six vertices. The full text of the 1985 enumeration paper was not accessible for a complete priority comparison; unindexed historical tables remain possible.
title: Three exact Fourier-cancellation motifs for five-vertex chordal graphs, and six-vertex recovery
